comments.author: Speenks
comments.body_html:
Hi there Mr Fountain. I’m a big fan of your mod for its systems, but as far as balance goes, real life is cruel in the realm of balance. I aimed to make a more arcadey spread so that finding or buying.. for example, an endgame helmet such as a Rys-T would feel rewarding. I wasn’t happy that helmets are practically vanity items against even basic rifle rounds. And while I understand that that is how they are in reality, for a game I drummed up my own vision.

Here is a spreadsheet of my madness

There are tabs at the bottom that cover most if not all things affected by this mod and/or my other mods. Thanks for stopping by :)
